subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Loud sounds may frighten them.”?
options: Another passenger heard this and shared a story about a bird that flew home from far away.
The bird house will be closed from 1:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m. today for cleaning.
Just before the photo, a bird flew over and dropped something white on Jack's shoulder.
The classroom became quiet again, but the students missed the bird a little.
